fact: The journal article says Botswana adopted LAPCAS but village-level addressing remains unresolved, and the authors built a prototype location addressing system for Tlokweng using Python, GeoPandas and Django.

Assistant Minister of Local Government Talita Monnakgotla told Parliament that street names for Tonota West, determined by Central District council in 2017, would be installed before the end of the 2023/24 financial year after delays from competing priorities.
